YONGYONG 鱅鱅 is called a fish but the main text says it RESEMBLES A LI OX (如犂牛), and Guo Pu glosses the ox as TIGER-PATTERNED (牛似虎文者). Draw a lean elongated OX, facing LEFT in quiet strict side profile, with one genuine cattle head, broad squared muzzle, bovine ears, exactly FOUR sturdy legs ending in cloven hooves, and one thin ox tail ending in a small brush. Hornless head is a deliberate artistic choice. Warm ivory hide with a few broad dark charcoal TIGER STRIPES following the trunk, not spots or flame scrolls. Slightly raised alert head and long low rectangular body distinguish it from stocky dark ox creatures. Its sound resembles a pig; do NOT add a pig snout, pig ears, fish fins, fish tail, gills, wings, extra heads or extra legs. All four hooves separate and visible.
assets.review_note: 牛状一头、四条足胫和四组裂蹄，无鱼鳍或猪首；虎纹依据郭注牛似虎文者，无角、配色、四足及侧身姿态为解释。
